name: Hunter Tracking
author: Beinded (JuanBerta)
description: Track specific animals and see them as green map markers on the in-game M-key map (personal WorldMarker layer) plus the green silhouette highlight (HighlightPurpose.Common, no talent needed). Markers follow the animals live and are cleared when an animal dies, leaves the range or is removed. Add, remove, list or clear tracked species with simple commands, tune the visible range, species limit and highlight limit, and use /ht locate to get live bearing, distance and coordinates of the nearest tracked animal.
